item.title: New feature alert!
item.description:
Working on this blog site. There is always room for improvement. One such improvement is adding a little search bar. Thinking about how an RSS feed approach might work or if a lightweight index is better. Still figuring out the plumbing behind it to keep things efficient and dependency-free.

Will keep the blog updated. Cheers!

item.title: How I built this blog
item.description:
This blog is plain python, HTML and CSS, no frameworks. Each post is a text file whose name carries the date and slug with the title on the first line.

I write posts in an admin page which only runs on my own laptop. When I hit publish, it builds a static HTML pages and pushes to GitHub pages, so nothing runs on the public side[as of now, I have new features coming which may change this].

For now there is an RSS feed to follow along.

item.title: Blogs used to be about thinking
item.description:
I am starting this blog because I miss the kind of blog that was just someone thinking out loud. Somewhere along the way a lot of blogs became tutorials and documentation, which are useful, but they leave out the part where you get stuck and change your mind.

Vlogs are a good comparison. A vlog is basically a blog in video form, and nobody expects one to be a manual. It’s just someone recording their journey, which is closer to what blogs were supposed to be.

So this is my attempt at that, short notes on what I’m building and learning, mistakes included. It’s also, honestly, a project to show how I work, so I wrote the whole thing from scratch in plain Python and HTML, with no frameworks.
